roadmap.scope: Epic #6136 (E1) only: slice 01 = US-01 refinement states in Team Settings (ADO Story #6139), slice 02 = US-02 Refinement tab list in backlog order (ADO Story #6140). E2-E5 (slices 03-19) are not in this roadmap.
roadmap.goal: A Team admin names which of the Team's To Do and Doing states mean refinement, under Team Settings -> Refinement; the Team then carries the fact refinementConfigured and a Refinement tab between Metrics and Settings switches on. Opening the tab lists exactly the Work Items in those states, in the tracker's backlog order, each with id + link, name, state, category and (Doing rows only) Work Item Age. Done when: every pending DISTILL scenario (backend 32 methods / 34 cases, frontend 32 cases) is un-ignored or un-skipped and green; the E2E walking skeleton in Refinement.spec.ts is un-fixme'd and has been run live against a locally-started app; the one EF migration (AddRefinementSettingsToTeams) exists for both providers, generated by Create-Migration.ps1, expand-only; dotnet build has zero warnings and the connector-excluded backend suite is green; pnpm test and pnpm build are clean; SonarQube Cloud reports no new issue.
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta property-based unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply, and leaving it out is a decision. This is C# .NET 10 + NUnit 4.6 + WebApplicationFactory + ArchUnitNET on the backend and TypeScript + Vitest + React Testing Library on the frontend, with Playwright page objects for E2E; there is no Hypothesis. The acceptance scenarios were written at DISTILL (Quinn) and the crafter authors none of them. RED = remove [Ignore(PendingSlice0n)] or turn it.skip into it, one scenario at a time, and watch it fail for the reason distill/red-classification.md records (MISSING_FUNCTIONALITY for every case). A test that fails for any other reason is a harness problem and is fixed before production code. GREEN = production code. Crafter-written tests beyond DISTILL's are limited to: the DST-14 demo-data scenario (01-06), the E7 pin that refinement members never make WorkItemRelatedSettingsChanged true (01-01), value-in/value-out unit cases for the pure RefinementSettingsValidator and the backlog-order ladder so Stryker has inner-loop kills (the acceptance category is excluded from Stryker), and the ArchUnitNET rules E1/E3/E6 that DESIGN assigns to the slice introducing each type.
